other_failure_modes.name: hardcoded_submission_id
other_failure_modes.description: The agent ignores the test set's identifier column and hardcodes the submission IDs as a numerical range (e.g., `np.arange`), which will cause scoring to fail if specific string IDs (like Patient_Week) are expected by the evaluation system.

other_failure_modes.name: improper_longitudinal_feature_usage
other_failure_modes.description: The agent uses 'Percent' (a target-dependent variable) as a predictor and to rescale targets. Because this feature is typically only known at baseline, imputing missing future test values with a global median destroys patient-specific trajectories and severely corrupts predictions.

summary: The agent implements a regression pipeline with patient-grouped validation and a weighted ensemble of gradient boosting models. However, it critically fails to engineer necessary longitudinal features (like baseline FVC) and inappropriately relies on the 'Percent' feature, which acts as a target leak at baseline and will corrupt future predictions when imputed with a median. Furthermore, the agent hardcodes submission IDs, which will likely break task evaluation.
